instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Free the places whose hold time has run out, and offer each to the waitlist", and give it ledger (the capacity ledger you hold).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:expire-old-holds and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Ends every confirmed hold whose expiry has passed by this run's clock and, by default, promotes one waiting entry into each freed place.
4. It reads and keeps nothing: it works from your request and answers its whole result; you keep the ledger it answers.
